Prosperous

/PROS-per-us/ — stress on PROS · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Prosperous describes someone or something that is successful and financially well-off.

The bakery grew so prosperous that it opened three new branches in a year.

Worked Example

After a decade of struggling with thin margins, the restaurant became so prosperous that the owner could finally afford to retire comfortably.

Prosper (to thrive; to succeed) + -ous (full of) = full of success and thriving. The base verb 'prosper' is a real English word, and the suffix transforms this action into a describing word for the restaurant's state. Comfort in retirement signals sustained wealth—the proof of prosperity.

How Prosperous Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

successful

successful: achieving the goals one set out for

thriving

thriving: growing vigorously stronger and healthier

affluent

affluent: having plenty of money and possessions

Antonyms

impoverished

impoverished: made poor; stripped of money or resources

destitute

destitute: lacking even the basic necessities of life

How Strong Is It? — stable → comfortable → thriving → prosperous

stable vs. prosperous

stable vs. prosperous: A stable business pays its bills on time, but a prosperous one grows genuinely wealthy.

comfortable vs. prosperous

comfortable vs. prosperous: A comfortable family has what it needs; a prosperous family has far more than it needs.

thriving vs. prosperous

thriving vs. prosperous: A thriving shop is doing well, but a prosperous shop has turned that success into real wealth.

Build the Word

The pieces

Root — prosper

Root — prosper: to thrive, to succeed (a real English verb) (Latin (prosperare))

Suffix — -ous

Suffix — -ous: full of (Latin (-osus))

Put it together

Put it together: Prosper is a verb you already know — to thrive or succeed. Add -ous ('full of') and prosperous means 'full of success': thriving so steadily that wealth follows.

Word Choice

neutral

Use prosperous when describing someone or something that is doing well financially or thriving with sustained success. Especially effective when the prosperity is visible, established, and enabling further growth or comfort.
